pitch-black.$description: Pitch Black — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

midnight.$description: Midnight — Filled action button backgrounds (Try Chronicle, Talk to sales, Try for free); icon fills; strongest contrast anchor

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Navigation link text and active nav states

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Footer fine print and copyright text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, UI borders, ghost button borders and text — the workhorse mid-tone

pewter.$description: Pewter — Secondary body copy and captions

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled or inactive button text and borders

silver.$description: Silver — Subtle background dividers and muted separators

fog.$description: Fog — Card borders, image borders, input borders — the hairline rule color

limestone.$description: Limestone — Alternating section backgrounds, testimonial section canvas, muted surface fills

cloud.$description: Cloud — Primary page canvas, card surfaces, link text on filled black buttons

diatype.$description: Single typeface for the entire system — headings, body, nav, buttons. Weight 400 for body and secondary text; weight 500 for prominent headings and CTAs. Negative tracking of -0.03em at display sizes creates mechanical compression uncommon in SaaS type — the letterforms feel pressed into the page rather than set on it. No serif, no decorative fallback: if Diatype is absent, the design loses its primary identity marker.
